theme.description: Theme configuration as an open union; accepts blog.pckt.theme and future types.

basePath.description: Base URL path for the publication (e.g., https://blog.pckt.blog)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the publication was first created

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the publication was last updated (optional)

items.description: Open union of extension objects identified by $type (NSID).

extensions.description: Extension objects (open union) for additional features

showCredit.description: Whether to display credit line on the publication

showInDiscover.description: Whether documents from this publication should appear in public discover feeds

description: A publication (blog) record representing a collection of documents. Contains metadata, branding, theme configuration, and optional extensions. Publications serve as the parent container for blog documents.
